# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Brother, the enemy doesn't attack weak spots he can't see. He attacks the gaps—the unguarded moments, the unchecked thoughts, the lazy habits you dismiss as "small." Paul's command here isn't a suggestion; it's a battle order. *Watch* means your eyes are open, scanning the horizon for compromise. *Stand fast* means your feet are planted, refusing to be moved by pressure or temptation. *Be brave* means you face the fight even when your hands shake. *Be strong* means you draw on a strength not your own—the Spirit's power, not your pride.

Men, we don't drift into holiness; we fight for it. A soldier doesn't sleep on his post, and a warrior doesn't hope the battle passes him by. Today, identify one gap in your armor—a habit, a relationship, a thought pattern—and close it. Don't just pray about it; act on it. God has given you the equipment; now use it.

## Daily Challenge
Do 30 pushups. With every rep, say, "I stand firm in Christ." Then text a brother and ask him to hold you accountable to one gap you're closing today.
